prompt.en: The sandbox has an in-memory PostgreSQL (node's `pg` driver). In query.js: `import pg from "pg"`, create a pool, `CREATE TABLE items (title TEXT)` (columns: `id` is added automatically), insert three rows ('apples', 'bread', 'milk') with `INSERT INTO items (title) VALUES (…)` one by one, then `SELECT * FROM items` and store the rows in `globalThis.result` (an array of {id, title}).
prompt.ru: В песочнице есть in-memory PostgreSQL (драйвер `pg` для node). В query.js: `import pg from "pg"`, создай пул, `CREATE TABLE items (title TEXT)` (колонка `id` добавляется автоматически), вставь три строки ('apples', 'bread', 'milk') через `INSERT INTO items (title) VALUES (…)` по одной, затем `SELECT * FROM items` и сохрани строки в `globalThis.result` (массив {id, title}).

tests.name: 3 rows
tests.code: const r = globalThis.result; assert(Array.isArray(r) && r.length === 3, "expected 3 rows, got " + (r && r.length));

tests.name: titles
tests.code: const titles = (globalThis.result || []).map((x) => x.title); assert(JSON.stringify(titles) === JSON.stringify(['apples', 'bread', 'milk']), "expected apples/bread/milk, got " + JSON.stringify(titles));

tests.name: ids auto
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result.every((x) => typeof x.id === 'number'), "each row must have a numeric id");

hint.en: const pool = new pg.Pool(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE items (title TEXT)'); … pool.end().
hint.ru: const pool = new pg.Pool(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE items (title TEXT)'); … pool.end().

prompt.en: The `users` table is pre-populated (1 user). Insert a new user `INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES ('Grace', 45) RETURNING *` and store the returned row in `globalThis.result`. Then verify with `SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM users` that the table now has 2 rows — store `n` in `globalThis.count`.
prompt.ru: Таблица `users` посеяна (1 пользователь). Вставь нового `INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES ('Grace', 45) RETURNING *` и сохрани возвращённую строку в `globalThis.result`. Затем проверь через `SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM users`, что в таблице стало 2 строки — сохрани `n` в `globalThis.count`.

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE users (name TEXT, age INT)'); await pool.query('INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES ($1, $2)', ['Ada', 36]);

tests.name: returned row
tests.code: const r = globalThis.result; assert(r && r.name === 'Grace' && r.age === 45 && typeof r.id === 'number', "expected { id, name: 'Grace', age: 45 }, got " + JSON.stringify(r));

tests.name: count is 2
tests.code: assert(globalThis.count === 2, "expected count 2, got " + globalThis.count);

hint.en: RETURNING * makes INSERT return the inserted row: res.rows[0].
hint.ru: RETURNING * заставляет INSERT вернуть вставленную строку: res.rows[0].

prompt.en: The `products` table is pre-populated (5 products: id, name, price). Write a parameterized query `SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > $1` with the parameter [50] and store the rows in `globalThis.result` (sorted by name — add `ORDER BY name`). Then `UPDATE products SET price = price WHERE id = $1`… no: just `UPDATE products SET price = 99 WHERE id = $1` for the product with id 1, and store the updated price of id 1 in `globalThis.updated` (read it back with SELECT).
prompt.ru: Таблица `products` посеяна (5 товаров: id, name, price). Напиши параметризованный запрос `SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > $1` с параметром [50] и сохрани строки в `globalThis.result` (отсортированные по имени — добавь `ORDER BY name`). Затем `UPDATE products SET price = 99 WHERE id = $1` для товара с id 1 и сохрани обновлённую цену id 1 в `globalThis.updated` (прочитай через SELECT).

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE products (name TEXT, price INT)'); const prod = [['Keyboard', 80], ['Mouse', 30], ['Monitor', 250], ['Webcam', 60], ['Hub', 25]]; for (const [n, pr] of prod) { await pool.query('INSERT INTO products (name, price) VALUES ($1, $2)', [n, pr]); }

tests.name: filter by price
tests.code: const names = (globalThis.result || []).map((x) => x.name); assert(JSON.stringify(names) === JSON.stringify(['Keyboard', 'Monitor', 'Webcam']), "expected Keyboard/Monitor/Webcam, got " + JSON.stringify(names));

tests.name: updated price
tests.code: assert(globalThis.updated === 99, "expected 99, got " + globalThis.updated);

hint.en: pool.query('SELECT … WHERE price > $1 ORDER BY name', [50]) — parameters protect from SQL-injection.
hint.ru: pool.query('SELECT … WHERE price > $1 ORDER BY name', [50]) — параметры защищают от SQL-инъекций.

prompt.en: The `messages` table is pre-populated (6 messages: id, body, read boolean). (1) Delete all unread messages: `DELETE FROM messages WHERE read = $1` with [false]… the sandbox compares values literally — use `WHERE read = false` (a boolean literal) and store the number of deleted rows in `globalThis.deleted` (result.rowCount). (2) Take the first 2 remaining (read) messages: `SELECT * FROM messages ORDER BY id LIMIT 2` → `globalThis.result`.
prompt.ru: Таблица `messages` посеяна (6 сообщений: id, body, read — boolean). (1) Удали все непрочитанные: `DELETE FROM messages WHERE read = false` (булевый литерал) и сохрани число удалённых строк в `globalThis.deleted` (result.rowCount). (2) Возьми первые 2 оставшихся (прочитанных): `SELECT * FROM messages ORDER BY id LIMIT 2` → `globalThis.result`.

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE messages (body TEXT, read BOOL)'); const msgs = [['m1', true], ['m2', false], ['m3', true], ['m4', false], ['m5', true], ['m6', false]]; for (const [b, r] of msgs) { await pool.query('INSERT INTO messages (body, read) VALUES ($1, $2)', [b, r]); }

tests.name: 3 deleted
tests.code: assert(globalThis.deleted === 3, "expected 3 deleted, got " + globalThis.deleted);

tests.name: first 2 read
tests.code: const bodies = (globalThis.result || []).map((x) => x.body); assert(JSON.stringify(bodies) === JSON.stringify(['m1', 'm3']), "expected m1/m3, got " + JSON.stringify(bodies));

tests.name: 3 left in table
tests.code: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); const r = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM messages'); assert(r.rows[0].n === 3, "expected 3 rows left, got " + r.rows[0].n);

hint.en: DELETE returns rowCount; LIMIT 2 + ORDER BY id — a deterministic page.
hint.ru: DELETE возвращает rowCount; LIMIT 2 + ORDER BY id — детерминированная «страница».

prompt.en: Two pre-populated tables: `authors` (id, name) and `books` (id, title, author_id). Write the SQL for an inner join in `globalThis.result.sql`: `SELECT authors.name, books.title FROM books INNER JOIN authors ON books.author_id = authors.id ORDER BY books.title` — the sandbox verifies the shape of the query. Then actually produce the joined rows in JS (map books to their author names) and store them in `globalThis.result.rows` as an array of `{ name, title }` sorted by title.
prompt.ru: Две посеянные таблицы: `authors` (id, name) и `books` (id, title, author_id). Напиши SQL внутреннего соединения в `globalThis.result.sql`: `SELECT authors.name, books.title FROM books INNER JOIN authors ON books.author_id = authors.id ORDER BY books.title` — песочница проверит форму запроса. Затем реально произведи соединение в JS (сопоставь книги с именами авторов) и сохрани в `globalThis.result.rows` массив `{ name, title }`, отсортированный по title.

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE authors (name TEXT)'); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE books (title TEXT, author_id INT)'); await pool.query('INSERT INTO authors (name) VALUES ($1)', ['Ada']); await pool.query('INSERT INTO authors (name) VALUES ($1)', ['Linus']); const books = [['SICP', 1], ['The Art of Unix', 2], ['Lisp for You', 1]]; for (const [b, a] of books) { await pool.query('INSERT INTO books (title, author_id) VALUES ($1, $2)', [b, a]); }

tests.name: sql shape
tests.code: const sql = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.sql) || ''; assert(/INNER\s+JOIN/i.test(sql) && /ON\s+books\.author_id\s*=\s*authors\.id/i.test(sql) && /FROM\s+books/i.test(sql), "expected an inner join of books ON author_id, got: " + sql);

tests.name: joined rows
tests.code: const rows = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.rows) || []; const got = rows.map((r) => r.name + '|' + r.title).join(';'); assert(got === 'Ada|Lisp for You;Ada|SICP;Linus|The Art of Unix', "expected joined+sorted rows, got: " + got);

hint.en: Read both tables, build a map authorId → name, and for each book compose { name, title }; sort by title.
hint.ru: Прочитай обе таблицы, собери map authorId → name и для каждой книги собери { name, title }; отсортируй по title.

prompt.en: Tables `users` (id, name) and `orders` (id, user_id, amount) are pre-populated; one user has no orders. Implement in JS the LEFT JOIN semantics `users LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id`: every user appears at least once; a user without orders gets `amount: null`. Store in `globalThis.result` an array of `{ name, amount }` (a user with several orders — one row per order) sorted by name, and in `globalThis.result.sql` the query `SELECT users.name, orders.amount FROM users LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id`.
prompt.ru: Таблицы `users` (id, name) и `orders` (id, user_id, amount) посеяны; у одного пользователя нет заказов. Реализуй в JS семантику LEFT JOIN: `users LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id` — каждый пользователь появляется хотя бы раз; у пользователя без заказов `amount: null`. В `globalThis.result` — массив `{ name, amount }` (у пользователя с несколькими заказами — строка на каждый заказ), отсортированный по name, а в `globalThis.result.sql` — запрос `SELECT users.name, orders.amount FROM users LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id`.

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE users (name TEXT)'); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE orders (user_id INT, amount INT)'); for (const n of ['Ada', 'Ben', 'Cara']) { await pool.query('INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ($1)', [n]); } for (const [u, a] of [[1, 100], [1, 50], [2, 20]]) { await pool.query('INSERT INTO orders (user_id, amount) VALUES ($1, $2)', [u, a]); }

tests.name: sql shape
tests.code: const sql = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.sql) || ''; assert(/LEFT\s+JOIN/i.test(sql) && /users/i.test(sql) && /orders/i.test(sql) && /ON/i.test(sql), "expected LEFT JOIN users/orders, got: " + sql);

tests.name: rows
tests.code: const rows = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.rows) || []; const got = rows.map((r) => r.name + '|' + r.amount).join(';'); assert(got === 'Ada|100;Ada|50;Ben|20;Cara|null', "expected Ada×2, Ben×1, Cara×null sorted by name, got: " + got);

hint.en: For each user: take their orders; if none — one row with amount: null. Then sort all rows by name.
hint.ru: Для каждого пользователя: бери его заказы; если нет — одна строка с amount: null. Потом все строки — по имени.

prompt.en: The tables `users` and `orders` are pre-populated. In JS compute: for every user — the total amount of their orders (users without orders → 0). Store in `globalThis.result.rows` an array of `{ name, total }` sorted by total descending, and in `globalThis.result.sql` the query: `SELECT users.name, COALESCE(SUM(orders.amount), 0) AS total FROM users LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id GROUP BY users.name ORDER BY total DESC` (the sandbox checks the shape).
prompt.ru: Таблицы `users` и `orders` посеяны. В JS вычисли: для каждого пользователя — сумму заказов (без заказов → 0). В `globalThis.result.rows` — массив `{ name, total }` отсортированный по total по убыванию, а в `globalThis.result.sql` — запрос: `SELECT users.name, COALESCE(SUM(orders.amount), 0) AS total FROM users LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id GROUP BY users.name ORDER BY total DESC` (песочница проверит форму).

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE users (name TEXT)'); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE orders (user_id INT, amount INT)'); await pool.query("INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Ada')"); await pool.query("INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Ben')"); await pool.query("INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Cara')"); await pool.query("INSERT INTO orders (user_id, amount) VALUES (1, 100)"); await pool.query("INSERT INTO orders (user_id, amount) VALUES (1, 50)"); await pool.query("INSERT INTO orders (user_id, amount) VALUES (3, 300)");

tests.name: sql shape
tests.code: const sql = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.sql) || ''; assert(/GROUP\s+BY/i.test(sql) && /SUM\s*\(/i.test(sql) && /ORDER\s+BY\s+total\s+DESC/i.test(sql), "expected GROUP BY + SUM + ORDER BY total DESC, got: " + sql);

tests.name: totals
tests.code: const rows = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.rows) || []; const got = rows.map((r) => r.name + '|' + r.total).join(';'); assert(got === 'Cara|300;Ada|150;Ben|0', "expected Cara/Ada/Ben with totals, got: " + got);

hint.en: Sum orders per user_id; users without orders get 0 (COALESCE in SQL); sort descending.
hint.ru: Суммируй заказы по user_id; у пользователей без заказов — 0 (в SQL это COALESCE); сортируй по убыванию.

prompt.en: The `events` table is pre-populated (1000 rows: id, user_id, kind). (1) Write the index for fast lookups by user: store in `globalThis.result.sql` the query `CREATE INDEX idx_events_user ON events (user_id)`. (2) Implement in JS an in-memory index: a Map user_id → array of event ids, built from the table; `globalThis.indexFor(userId)` must return the event ids for that user (export a function `indexFor` from query.js).
prompt.ru: Таблица `events` посеяна (1000 строк: id, user_id, kind). (1) Напиши индекс для быстрого поиска по пользователю: в `globalThis.result.sql` — запрос `CREATE INDEX idx_events_user ON events (user_id)`. (2) Реализуй в JS индекс в памяти: Map user_id → массив event-id, построенный из таблицы; `globalThis.indexFor(userId)` должен возвращать event-id для этого пользователя (экспортируй функцию `indexFor` из query.js).

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE events (user_id INT, kind TEXT)'); const kinds = ['click', 'view', 'buy']; for (let i = 1; i <= 1000; i++) { await pool.query('INSERT INTO events (user_id, kind) VALUES (' + (i % 20 + 1) + ', ' + JSON.stringify(kinds[i % 3]) + ')'); }

tests.name: sql shape
tests.code: const sql = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.sql) || ''; assert(/CREATE\s+INDEX\s+idx_events_user\s+ON\s+events\s*\(user_id\)/i.test(sql), "expected the given CREATE INDEX, got: " + sql);

tests.name: index lookup
tests.code:
assert(typeof window.__userModule.indexFor === 'function', "export indexFor"); const ids = window.__userModule.indexFor(1); assert(Array.isArray(ids) && ids.length === 50, "user 1 must have 50 events, got " + (ids && ids.length));
assert(ids.every((x) => typeof x === 'number'), "ids must be numbers");

tests.name: missing user
tests.code: const ids = window.__userModule.indexFor(999); assert(ids === null || ids === undefined || (Array.isArray(ids) && ids.length === 0), "no events for user 999");

hint.en: SELECT * FROM events, then events.reduce building Map<user_id, number[]>.
hint.ru: SELECT * FROM events, затем reduce по строкам строит Map<user_id, number[]>.

prompt.en: The `sessions` table is pre-populated (id, token, user_id, created). The hot query is `SELECT user_id FROM sessions WHERE token = $1` (a login check). (1) Store in `globalThis.result.sql` a covering index: `CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_token ON sessions (token) INCLUDE (user_id)` (the sandbox checks the shape). (2) In JS: build the token → user_id map from the table and export `lookupByToken(token)` (returns user_id or null). The test will look up several tokens.
prompt.ru: Таблица `sessions` посеяна (id, token, user_id, created). Горячий запрос — `SELECT user_id FROM sessions WHERE token = $1` (проверка при входе). (1) В `globalThis.result.sql` — covering-индекс: `CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_token ON sessions (token) INCLUDE (user_id)` (песочница проверит форму). (2) В JS: собери map token → user_id из таблицы и экспортируй `lookupByToken(token)` (возвращает user_id или null). Тест поищет несколько токенов.

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE sessions (token TEXT, user_id INT, created TEXT)'); const toks = ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma', 'delta', 'epsilon']; for (let i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) { await pool.query('INSERT INTO sessions (token, user_id, created) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)', [toks[i], i + 1, '2026-09-01']); }

tests.name: sql shape
tests.code: const sql = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.sql) || ''; assert(/CREATE\s+INDEX\s+idx_sessions_token\s+ON\s+sessions\s*\(token\)\s+INCLUDE\s*\(user_id\)/i.test(sql), "expected a covering index with INCLUDE, got: " + sql);

tests.name: lookup
tests.code: const f = window.__userModule.lookupByToken; assert(typeof f === 'function', "export lookupByToken"); assert(f('alpha') === 1 && f('gamma') === 3 && f('epsilon') === 5, "tokens must map to their users"); assert(f('nope') === null, "unknown token → null");

hint.en: INCLUDE puts the column the query needs into the index — the table itself is not read (index-only scan).
hint.ru: INCLUDE кладёт в индекс колонку, которую нужен запрос — сама таблица не читается (index-only scan).

title.en: Query Plan: WHERE on Indexed Column
title.ru: План запроса: WHERE по индексированной колонке

prompt.en: The `logs` table is pre-populated (2000 rows: id, level, created_day). A slow report queries `SELECT * FROM logs WHERE level = $1` (params ['error']) — it must use the index `CREATE INDEX idx_logs_level ON logs (level)` (store it in `globalThis.result.sql`). Your job: (1) run the parameterized query and store the rows in `globalThis.result.rows` (they come back in id order — the sandbox keeps insertion order); (2) store the fraction of 'error' rows in `globalThis.result.fraction` (errors / total, rounded to 3 decimals).
prompt.ru: Таблица `logs` посеяна (2000 строк: id, level, created_day). Медленный отчёт запрашивает `SELECT * FROM logs WHERE level = $1` (параметры ['error']) — он должен использовать индекс `CREATE INDEX idx_logs_level ON logs (level)` (сохрани его в `globalThis.result.sql`). Твоя задача: (1) выполни параметризованный запрос и сохрани строки в `globalThis.result.rows` (они приходят в порядке id — песочница сохраняет порядок вставки); (2) в `globalThis.result.fraction` — долю строк 'error' (error / всего, округление до 3 знаков).

setup: const pool = new (globalThis.__shims.pg.Pool)(); await pool.query('CREATE TABLE logs (level TEXT, created_day TEXT)'); const lv = ['info', 'info', 'info', 'error']; for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) { await pool.query('INSERT INTO logs (level, created_day) VALUES ($1, $2)', [lv[i % 4], '2026-09-0' + (i % 9 + 1)]); }

tests.name: sql shape
tests.code: const sql = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.sql) || ''; assert(/CREATE\s+INDEX\s+idx_logs_level\s+ON\s+logs\s*\(level\)/i.test(sql), "expected the index on level, got: " + sql);

tests.name: 500 error rows
tests.code:
const rows = (globalThis.result && globalThis.result.rows) || []; assert(rows.length === 500, "expected 500 error rows, got " + rows.length);
assert(rows.every((r) => r.level === 'error'), "all rows must be 'error'");

tests.name: fraction 0.25
tests.code: assert(globalThis.result.fraction === 0.25, "expected 0.25, got " + globalThis.result.fraction);

hint.en: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM logs — the total; the WHERE-query result — the errors. Round: Math.round(x * 1000) / 1000.
hint.ru: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM logs — всего; результат WHERE-запроса — ошибок. Округление: Math.round(x * 1000) / 1000.
